title: Servo Current — Elevated Load on Axis
description: Servo current on {val}-axis P0{val2} = {val3} A, elevated {val4}% above baseline for equivalent move. Ball screw or guide resistance increasing.
probable_cause: Insufficient lubrication on linear guides or ball screw, guide wear, or contamination ingress.
diagnostic_steps: Manually jog axis and feel for stiction
Inspect linear guide surface for scoring
Check lubrication oil delivery to guides P040
remedy: Apply lubrication per maintenance schedule. If stiction persists, inspect guide rail and carriage.
required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.
escalation_path: If AXS-SR-002 is not addressed (complete current cycle then stop. schedule maintenance within 4 hours.), the fault will escalate in this order: LUB-MD-001, then AXS-MJ-001, then AXS-MN-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
